According to research by BrightLocal (published via GeoAura / AI local search tracking studies), Perplexity and local AI search metrics across analyzed market datasets showed that 93% of cited local domains were individual business websites, with Google Business Profile (GBP) supplying 28.5%, while alternative specialized tracking (such as Podqi's September 2026 AI shopping and brand-risk study) examined 6,795 answers across 151 brands.
